title: Manipur: CoTU announces sit-in protests across Kangpokpi from November 12

ai.summary: CoTU in Kangpokpi district announced sit-in protests starting November 12, 2026, protesting government's failure to address abduction and killing of two Kuki civilians from Taphou Kuki village.

facts.claim: CoTU announced sit-in protests across Kangpokpi district starting November 12, 2026
facts.quote: The Committee on Tribal Unity (CoTU), Sadar Hills, Kangpokpi district, has announced a series of peaceful sit-in demonstrations across the district from November 12, 2026, protesting what it described as the Manipur government’s failure to act on its Charter of Demands.

facts.claim: Protests will begin in Saikul before moving to Saparmaina and Kangpokpi District Headquarters
facts.quote: According to a press communique issued by the committee, the protests will begin in Saikul before moving to Saparmaina and the Kangpokpi District Headquarters.

facts.claim: Protests follow alleged government failure to address abduction and killing of two Kuki civilians from Taphou Kuki village
facts.quote: The proposed agitation follows the government’s alleged failure to address the abduction and killing of two Kuki civilians from Taphou Kuki village.

facts.claim: CoTU submitted Charter of Demands seeking justice and gave authorities seven days to resolve
facts.quote: CoTU said it had earlier submitted a Charter of Demands seeking justice and provided the authorities with seven days to come up with a concrete resolution.

facts.claim: Government failed to make meaningful progress on the issue
facts.quote: However, the committee alleged that the administration had remained silent and failed to make any meaningful progress.

facts.claim: Lack of action weakened public confidence in government's commitment to justice, security and governance
facts.quote: It said the lack of action had weakened public confidence in the government’s commitment to ensuring justice, security and good governance.

facts.claim: CoTU warned of intensifying protests if government fails to act within timeframe
facts.quote: The committee also warned that it might intensify its democratic agitation if the government failed to take satisfactory action within the stipulated timeframe.

ai.background_note: CoTU in Kangpokpi district announced sit-in protests starting November 12, 2026, protesting government's failure to address abduction and killing of two Kuki civilians from Taphou Kuki village.
